breakdown.description: The boundary condition of fixedValue (0 0.1 0) is set at outlet, but it should be the inlet.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly added the fixedValue boundary conditions to the inlet (matching the ground truth), but it also retained the same fixedValue conditions on the outlet patch (U.air fixedValue (0 0.1 0), alpha.air fixedValue 0.5, etc.). The ground truth only specifies these BCs at the inlet, not the outlet. The agent did not fully resolve the inconsistency because it kept the erroneous outlet boundary conditions from the incomplete prompt while also adding the correct inlet conditions.
